messages:
Maya: Hey team — we need a quota bump and project approval for a new pilot customer. Request: 8 x A100 (v4?), 6 x H100, and 12 x L4 GPUs in europe-west4 for project redwood-pilot-2026. Need to reserve for 3 months and enable external egress IPs (10 reserved EIPs) for model serving behind NAT.
Sam: Do we have the billing hostproject and org policy aligned? Which billing project will pay? OpsFinance needs cost estimate before approval. :money_with_wings:
Maya: Billing host project: infra-billing-prod. Expected spend ~ $48k/mo if fully used, but early usage will be lower. Pilot QPS ~ 120 req/s with ~1.5k token avg payload => steady GPU utilization. Will provide more detailed calc in a min.
Lee: Are we sure europe-west4 is best? capacity reports show limited H100 stock there this quarter. Maybe split H100 to europe-west1 + west4? Also watch multi-region egress costs.
Maya: Customer requires eu region for data residency. Can we do H100 fallback to west1? We want strict latency SLA for FR-based customers.
Andre: Two asks: (1) quota increase request template (we should include project id, billing, vm types, region, justification, duration) and (2) service account that will own VPC-SC and has KMS access. I'll add template below.
Andre: ```
Project: redwood-pilot-2026
Billing host: infra-billing-prod
Quotas: accelerator.googleapis.com/A100: 8
        accelerator.googleapis.com/H100: 6
        accelerator.googleapis.com/L4: 12
Region: europe-west4
Egress IPs: 10 (static external)
Duration: 90 days
Justification: customer pilot for low-latency LLM inference; production path dependent on pilot results
Contact: maya@redwood.com, infra-oncall@redwood.com
```
Maya: tagging @QuotaBot and infra-bot to kick the request. Can OpsFinance do quick signoff on the spending? We might front costs under pilot credits but need formal approval.
OpsFinance: Quick note — approve provisional spend up to $60k/mo for pilot. Need PO if it extends beyond 90 days. Please file internal cost center ID: CC-ML-42.
QuotaBot: Request submitted to google cloud support #SR-889412. ETA for review: 72 hours. Please attach org-level usage history if asked.
Sam: FYI I'll try to negotiate use of preemptible/spot for some L4 capacity to reduce cost. But H100/A100 must be guaranteed. Also we can consider autoscaler with node taints so non-critical jobs don't consume reserved GPUs.
Maya: Thanks. Also preflight checklist: 1) enable Compute API, 2) add service account redwood-gke-svc to hostproject with roles/compute.admin, roles/servicenetworking.admin, 3) reserve 10 static external IPs, 4) verify firewall NAT rules. I'll open a PR with infra-oncall checklist.
Lee: One more note — GCP may require quota tied to the billing account and organization policy. If they ask we should show recent commit history of similar projects (link: https://go/reports/gpu-usage). I'll grab logs and share.
Maya: Ok I'll attach the calc and the PR. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Created internal ticket INFRA-3247 for resource provisioning. Assignee: Andre. SLA: 3 business days for preflight + quota approval processing.
Andre: Picking this up. Will ping when SR updates land. If SR stalls we can request quota escalation via account manager.
Maya: Closing loop — will update thread once SR resolves
